screener_description: Satin Network Limited (SCNL) is a leading microfinance institution (MFI) with presence in 23 states & union territory and 95,000 villages. The company offers a bouquet of financial products in the Non‐MFI segment (comprising loans to MSMEs), a housing finance subsidiary, and business correspondent services and similar services to other financial Institutions through Taraashna Financial Services Limited (TFSL), a business correspondent company and a 100% subsidiary of SCNL. [1]
